EC1: - Participant is mentally [OR] or legally incapacitated at the time of the study;
EC2: - Known HIV(+) [OR] or has been diagnosed with AIDS
EC3: - Participation in another investigational drug study in the prior 4 weeks
EC4: - Positive pregnancy test in a female
EC5: - Patient, in the opinion of the investigator, is likely to be poorly compliant.
EC6: - Diffuse subependymal [OR] or Cerebral Spinal Fluid (CSF) disease
EC11: - Radiation [OR] or chemotherapy within 4 weeks of enrollment
EC12: - Systemic diseases associated with unacceptable anesthesia [OR] or operative risk
EC13: - [NOT] Inability to undergo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
